METHOD HAS REBUILT BOTH LISTS FOR SEASON 2 and the era-verify observation moved with it: seasonVerified s1 -> s2 on raid and mplus. Evidence read live: the raid page self-dates "Last Updated 10th August 2026" and describes "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss"; the M+ page self-dates 13th August and opens "welcome to Method's Mythic+ Spec and Dungeon Tier List for Midnight Season 2" (Tactyks). Both pages carried ZERO occurrences of 12.1/Season 2 as recently as yesterday. Parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched (the rejected alts are the 8 dungeon names and the site logo), 51 tier moves - a wholly new list, including Vengeance DH which was ABSENT from the raid list and is now rated B. Consequence, by design not by accident: a season-AHEAD outlet leaves the live consensus and becomes a next-patch forecast input, and publish's deterministic freeze-season step lifts Method's final s1 letters from git history into the frozen lane so the consensus keeps its composition. Simulated here with method's HEAD letters injected into the frozen lane, consensus movement vs the baseline snapshot falls from 31 moves to 14 (0 two-band, 0 vanished) - see anomalyAckProposal.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag (specTierListSection.tierLists[], metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+, never the default popularity grouping; spec read from each entry's "Class-Spec" icon). 80 assignments, 0 unmatched. 26 tier moves, ALL RAID (Fire Mage B->S, Holy Paladin C->S, Prot Warrior A->S, Discipline Priest A->C, Mistweaver S->B ...); every M+ letter is byte-identical. THE CAUSE IS SAMPLE COLLAPSE, NOT A RETUNE: Season 1 ended with 12.1 on 08-11 and Archon's raid pool has fallen off a cliff - per-spec parses now sum to 6435 on the DPS page (897 tank, 1582 healer) against 219704 in the 08-12 cut, a ~97% drop, with single specs down from 13674 to 527 parses. The M+ pool is untouched (2.5M parses, per-spec counts byte-identical to stored). Archon's lastUpdated reads 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z. Era: the pages still describe Season 1 content (the nine S1 bosses, the eight S1 dungeons), so seasonVerified stays s1 - with Method now ahead, Archon is the ONLY source still feeding the live consensus in its own right, which is why its churn matters more than usual tonight.

Full re-fetch of 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200. 185 per-encounter moves, ALL RAID; every M+ per-dungeon tier is byte-identical. Two bosses now publish an EMPTY throughput tier list upstream - Crown (142/38/20 parses across the three roles) and Chimaerus (299/42/39) - while their survivability lists still populate, so this is the same S1 sample collapse seen in archon-tiers, not a parse failure (verified by re-fetching both pages on their own). Per the standing "empty = nothing to ingest" rule those two encounters' 40 stored rows each were LEFT UNTOUCHED rather than erased; likewise the empty tank cut on Vanguard. Vaelgor & Ezzorak legitimately lost 2 specs Archon no longer rates there (Affliction Warlock, Vengeance DH). File now holds 678 tier rows (was 680, floor 440). asOf set to Archon's own cut date 2026-08-14, never the run date.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages (metric "survivability" specifically): 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, merged at Archon's cut date 2026-08-14. 18 tiers moved (Elemental Shaman S->A, Blood DK A->B, Holy Paladin C->B ...). Same caveat as the throughput list: the raid sample behind these tiers collapsed ~97% with the end of Season 1, so a single-night move here is weak evidence.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) on the raid DPS + raid tank pages = 33 rows, each with n = that spec's parse count. A genuine new cut: all 33 values moved (Devourer DH 182517 -> 164381, Elemental Shaman 173718 -> 188899) and every parse count collapsed with the end of Season 1 (Devourer 13674 -> 527, Unholy DK 17203 -> 477). No single row moved more than 50%, so the value-move guard is untouched, but the honest caveat now lives in n: these are 95th percentiles over a few hundred parses. Merged at Archon's own cut date 2026-08-14. The raid healer page also exposes a dps column (healer DPS); it is excluded here exactly as the stored 33-row shape has always excluded it.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses, all seven values and parse counts moving with the same 2026-08-14 cut and the same post-Season-1 sample collapse (n now 105-352 per spec). Merged at Archon's cut date. Emitted as its own row rather than folded into archon-metrics so a failure of one series can never be hidden by the other.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column: 40/40 specs parsed cleanly, and all 40 scores AND all 40 parse counts are byte-identical to stored for the fourth consecutive run - the M+ cut has not re-run since 2026-08-10 even though the page label advanced to 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z. Re-stamping an unchanged cut with a fresher date is exactly the failure the bloodmallet/wowmeta asOf rule exists to prevent, so nothing was merged and the rows stay at 2026-08-10 (4 days, maxAgeDays 5). The parse-count column, not lastUpdated, is Archon's re-cut detector: it moved on every raid page tonight and on no M+ page.

80 rows parsed (40 raid + 40 M+) from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention. The RAID half moved with the 2026-08-14 re-cut (39 of 40 values changed) and was merged at that date; the M+ half is byte-identical to stored - same parse counts, same fractions - and was deliberately left alone rather than re-stamped. The family's coverage date is therefore the unchanged M+ half at 2026-08-10 (the probe takes the 60th-freshest of 80 rows), which is what previousAsOf/newAsOf report and why this is partial rather than success.

anomalyAckProposal: Consensus movement tonight is a registry event plus an upstream sample collapse, not a parse bug. (1) Method rebuilt both tier lists for Season 2 (raid self-dated 10 Aug, M+ 13 Aug, both naming "Midnight Season 2" / "The Venomous Abyss"; https://www.method.gg/guides/tier-list/raiding and /mythic-plus), so seasonVerified moved s1 -> s2 and Method leaves the live consensus. The publish job's deterministic freeze-season step restores its final s1 letters before the gate runs; simulated with those letters injected, movement drops from 31 to 14 with 0 two-band moves and 0 vanished cells, i.e. inside the 25/6 limits. (2) The residual 14 moves are all RAID and all Archon's, whose Season-1 raid pool collapsed ~97% with the 08-11 launch (per-spec parses 219704 -> 6435; single specs 13674 -> 527, and Crown/Chimaerus now publish empty throughput lists). Archon is the only source still feeding the live consensus in its own right, so its thin-sample churn passes straight through. Nothing was edited to soften this.
